rows.grounds: root car, third person singular optative

items.question: What practice is prescribed for the chief puṣpiṇī mantra kaheti?
premises: puṣpiṇī is called the chief one
all of that should be practiced always
items.inference: The practitioner should always practice all that belongs to the chief puṣpiṇī mantra kaheti.
uncertainties: technical sense of puṣpiṇī in this mantra context is not fully specified
items.plain_english: The mantra kaheti is the chief puṣpiṇī; one should always practice all of it.
